race_grid.title: Race Portrait Grid
race_grid.about: Grid of the race portraits plus the Custom Race tile; a click selects a race.

info_panel.title: Race Info Panel
info_panel.about: Framed panel behind the selected race's picture, name, description and traits; hidden in picture mode.

race_picture.title: Race Picture
race_picture.about: The selected race's banner picture at the top of the info panel.

race_name.title: Race Name
race_name.about: The selected race's name, drawn above the description.

race_description.title: Race Description
race_description.about: Scrollable description text of the selected race; it shrinks to fit its text.

race_traits.title: Race Traits
race_traits.about: Trait cards and government of the selected race, below the description; hover shows a trait's full text.
